reports.title: iRhythm Holdings Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Annual Guidance
section: For the full year 2026, iRhythm expects revenue between $890 million and $895 million, which includes approximately $16 million of expected VitalConnect revenue contribution from the October 5, 2026 acquisition close through year-end. iRhythm also expects adjusted EBITDA margin between 15.5% and 16.0%, inclusive of VitalConnect. iRhythm’s guidance reflects continued volume-led growth and operating leverage while maintaining disciplined investment in innovation and market expansion.
